bio: The Ivy Asia Chelsea features interiors that have a luxurious and theatrical Asian inspired design, from the dazzling green stone floor to the stunning antique décor on display.  The Afternoon Tea menu has an Asian twist, with savouries including spicy avocado maki rolls and a selection of sweet treats such as vanilla & sesame creme brulee and raspberry macaroons. For an extra-special occasion, make it a day to remember by adding a glass of Champagne.  The Ivy Asia Chelsea is located on King's Road in the heart of the exclusive borough of Kensington and Chelsea.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 3pm to 4.45pm and costs £32.95 per person, or £42.95 with a glass of Champagne. Minimum booking 2 people.
